name: dblens
description: Multi-agent audit of a PostgreSQL or SQL Server database: specialised agents run the dblens tools, a verifier re-runs every finding, and a report keeps the evidence. Read-only; no row data.

pg_connection.title: PostgreSQL connection string
pg_connection.description: A read-only login is recommended. Leave empty to use dblens's default (the local demo).

ss_connection.title: SQL Server connection string
ss_connection.description: A read-only login is recommended. Leave empty to use dblens's default (the local demo).
